summary: A supplied vector reconstruction of the Ocean Falls Corporation OFC trademark, drawn from the CIPO artwork for application 0390863 and checked against the 31 May 1977 USPTO Official Gazette (see package-README.md and review/comparison.webp). The US trademark image and the CIPO artwork are kept as downloads.

assets.label: Ocean Falls Corporation — OFC trademark
assets.sourceLocator: CIPO application 0390863, OFC DESIGN; USPTO Official Gazette, 31 May 1977, p. TM 241
assets.notes: The letters OFC in a heavy forward slant, the corporation’s newsprint trademark. It was filed in the United States in March 1976 and registered in August 1977, and also filed in Canada.
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied vector reconstruction, not original artwork: three hand-built letter paths sheared to a measured slant, drawn after the CIPO artwork and checked against the 1977 Gazette; no automatic tracing. Black follows the monochrome trademark artwork.
